AbilityDef.label: resonance
AbilityDef.description:
Set the carrier's strikes ringing for thirty seconds. Any melee blow they land leaves that exact part resonating for about five seconds, and a second blow on the same part while the note is live takes it off the body - an arm, a hand, a leg, an ear, torn away by its own ringing.

Which part rings is not up to anyone. It is wherever the blow happened to land, so this is pressure held on one body until the dice repeat, not a place the carrier can choose.

The note needs something that can ring. A torso, a neck, a head - anything with a life inside it - is too well damped to carry one, and blows there do nothing unusual. This takes people apart. It does not kill them.

The resonance does not know which side of the blow it is on. For the whole thirty seconds the carrier's own frame is ringing too, and anything that lands twice on the same part of them takes that part off as readily. Do not open this in a crowd.
